objective: Bounded scientific discovery of PD-L1 short-peptide design methods: iteratively propose and test evidence-grounded design hypotheses, compare and replicate independently generated candidates under the frozen MSA-free Boltz2/Chai1 scoring panel, measure locked-score repeatability, predictor agreement and generation yield, and reconcile results with campaign knowledge. A baseline and one intervention are milestones in ongoing discovery; continue across host-authorized batches while informative comparisons remain. Repeated verified method gaps may justify immutable skill refinement and independently paired shadow replay, coordinated by the campaign. Each contract budget applies to one trial; current job and campaign grants determine remaining trial counts. Stop for exhausted host grants, a genuine unresolved dependency, or a reasoned lack of an informative next comparison. Preserve the fixed target, evaluator, scoring pipeline and seeds. The one frozen scoring seed and unavailable upstream generator seed control limit replication and causal attribution; no multi-seed confirmation, reproducible method improvement or biological discovery may be inferred from a single favorable comparison.
